decision_rationale: The paper presents TISSUENARRATOR as a new framework that uses pretrained LLMs and next-token prediction to generate spatial transcriptomics outputs. The abstract and methods explicitly describe generation of cellular profiles and text, not just prediction or embedding.
evidence_snippet: "fine-tune an LLM to learn cell and text generation through next-token prediction"; "The model generates realistic, context-aware cellular profiles"; "leverages pretrained large language models (LLMs)"
